messages:
riley-marketing: Heads up team — SideLight case vignette is nearly finished. Need three quick things: 1) customer approval for a dashboard screenshot, 2) legal to clear a single 1-line quote for the blog + social, 3) routing plan for inbound leads (which SDR queue + UTM). Draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/SideLightCase (wip).

hao-cs: SideLight OK with the screenshot as long as we redact PII and hide internal IDs. They offered a sanitized export. Also said they'd prefer the headline emphasize reliability over raw numbers.

riley-marketing: Good. Please upload the sanitized screenshot to the assets folder and tag it 'for-legal'. I'll add two headline variants in the doc.

maya-legal: Quick checklist from legal: 1) we need the exact quote text to review, 2) any numeric claim must have a parenthetical citation to the internal benchmark, 3) no customer financial metrics without CFO signoff. Typical turnaround ~48 business hours unless there's a contentious claim.

hao-cs: Proposed short quote added to the doc under 'press-quote' — labeled 'for-legal':
- reliability-first: 'Redwood kept our inference pipeline steady during peak events, which saved the team hours each week.'
- numbers-first (for internal use): 'We saw an approximately 33% uplift in sustained throughput (internal benchmark, Nov 2025).'

maya-legal: Redlines: change 'kept our inference pipeline steady' -> 'helped maintain service stability', and replace 'saved the team hours each week' -> 'reduced incident toil for our engineering team'. For the numbers-first line change '33%' -> 'approximately 33%' and add '(internal benchmark, Nov 2025)'. Otherwise ok.

riley-marketing: Perfect — I updated the doc with legal's edits and marked the final quote 'legal-approved'. Customer confirmed they accept the legal phrasing and the sanitized screenshot. They asked that we embargo the case until their partner announcement on 2025-12-02.

jess-ops: Noted embargo. I can schedule the launch assets publish for 2025-12-03 09:00 PT and coordinate the webinar slot if you want a follow-up. Also: for inbound routing, do we want Growth's A/B to target Enterprise SDRs or Mixed?

growth-bot: Suggested routing: start campaign 2025-12-03 09:00 PT, UTM params: utm_source=redwood_blog&utm_campaign=sidelight_case&utm_medium=organic. A/B: Variant A -> Enterprise SDR queue, Variant B -> Growth SDR mixed queue. Recommend 60/40 split favoring Enterprise.

jess-ops: Routing scheduled per growth-bot recommendation. I'll provision the SDR handoff doc in the assets with two bullets for SDRs: 1) mention ease of integration, 2) lead indicator: if prospect runs models >100M tokens/day flag as high-priority.

riley-marketing: Thanks. Last items: PR to get the legal-approved quote + screenshot, Growth to get headline variants for A/B, Ops to schedule publish and route leads. I'll monitor embargo window and confirm publish time next week. :rocket:

hao-cs: Uploaded sanitized screenshot to assets and added caption. Customer also shared a short 45s clip from their Head of Product — added under 'multimedia'.

maya-legal: Final note: approved language saved in the doc as 'legal-approved' with timestamp. We're clear to hand to PR after embargo lifts.

riley-marketing: Great work everyone. Handing to PR + Growth for execution. Ping here if anything shifts. :white_check_mark:
